_note: Display-side copy rulings. The registry files in content/ are the Phase 0 record and are NEVER edited to satisfy a ruling — they keep the owner's original wording and figures. These rulings are applied at the one place content is read (readJson in src/lib/content.ts), so no page can print the ruled-out text, and tests/copy-rulings.spec.ts scans every rendered route to prove it. Each ruling names the DECISIONS.md entry it implements.

rulings.replace: with an additional charge per day upon request
rulings.why: Pool heating is available on request at an extra charge; the 35 € figure stays in the registry for the owner and is not printed. The replacement is the registry's OWN unpriced wording — villas 200, 201 and 202 already say exactly this — so nothing is composed, and the villa page's de-duplication folds the two variants into one line.

rulings.pattern: \s*also are the only seafront villas with private helipad(?: in the property)?
rulings.why: The geographic scope of 'the only seafront villas with private helipad' has never been verified. Until the owner verifies it, the page says 'with private helipad' and nothing more.
The same claim in any other phrasing — the Crete Holiday Home facts record carries it as a bare phrase.
